name: The White City Melt
prompt: Build a miniature city in pearly cooked rice on a black serving slab. Teams use chopsticks like long measuring rods. At one end the judges lift whole sculpted houses onto banana leaves for the waiting neighbours to eat.

name: One Grain High
prompt: Stand intricate filigree panels made by gluing rice grains edge to edge into tall open screens. Alternating ivory, black and purple grains cast lace shadows. A sculptor on a stool places the final grain into a broken arch.

name: The Great Mortar Ballet
prompt: Place shallow stone mortars in a staggered line beside a broad ochre cloth. Teams use suspended wooden pestles to shape sticky rice into long elastic figures, stretching one pale ribbon between two mortars as the judges pass.

name: The Edible Moon Calendar
prompt: Lay a row of giant rice moons in different phases on indigo mats. Families pinch bites from each bright disc to reveal its black sesame core. A last untouched sphere waits under a fine bamboo cage.

name: The Rice Paper Regatta
prompt: Float sculptures folded from translucent rice sheets in long narrow judging troughs. Bright grains serve as ballast in each delicate hull. One collapsing boat unfolds into a flat flower as spectators catch the drifting petals in sieves.
